abstract: Maintains fire suppression certifications and emergency egress corridor dimensions
system_message:
You are the Municipal life safety inspector (SAF), responsible for maintaining fire suppression certifications, verifying emergency egress corridor dimensions, and documenting emergency acoustic signaling records across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency acoustic signaling（ALARM）
information_points.content:
SAF-ALARM-IK9：For Yarra Riverfront Congress Centre, the evacuation alarm sound pressure level across public concourses during peak ambient crowd noise is 90 dB.
SAF-ALARM-RWU：For Docklands Maritime Exhibition Hub, the evacuation alarm sound pressure level across public concourses during peak ambient crowd noise is 85 dB.
SAF-ALARM-KS1：For Olympic Boulevard Pavilion Precinct, the evacuation alarm sound pressure level across public concourses during peak ambient crowd noise is 95 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains fire suppression certifications and emergency egress corridor dimensions（EGRESS）
information_points.content:
SAF-EGRESS-57X：At Yarra Riverfront Congress Centre, the automatic fire suppression system is certified across all exhibition halls and public circulation spaces, and the minimum emergency evacuation corridor width along primary delegate evacuation concourses is 3.6 m.
SAF-EGRESS-2E0：At Docklands Maritime Exhibition Hub, the automatic fire suppression system is certified across all exhibition halls and public circulation spaces, while the minimum emergency evacuation corridor width along primary delegate evacuation concourses is 2.8 m.
SAF-EGRESS-NVG：At Olympic Boulevard Pavilion Precinct, the automatic fire suppression system is certified across all exhibition halls and public circulation spaces, and the minimum emergency evacuation corridor width along primary delegate evacuation concourses is 3.6 m.
